programme.title: Baogu Produces -Cross Four Trails Challenge
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: Honest Candidate 2
programme.desc: After failing to win the Seoul mayoral election, Joo Sang-sook became an unemployable property and no parties will admit to associating with her in fear of bad press, but when she rescues a young man from drowning, she is suddenly pulled into spotlight and wins the election to become the Gangwon province governor. But her honesty sinks her approval rating and she resorts back to lying through her teeth. As fate would have it, her truth mouth returns! Not only that, her chief of staff Hee-cheol is cursed with the same truth bomb!

programme.title: The Exchange
programme.desc: Dojo and May are a loving couple. Because Dojo has a brain tumor and needs 1 million baht for the operation, they decide to rob a money exchange store. Unluckily, the couple with 10 unfortunate patrons of the money exchange center are held hostages by 3 professional robbers on the same day. It is a robbery inside another robbery as well as some secrets among these people will be revealed. What could possibly happen when these people are trapped in the store with no way to escape?

programme.desc: Rhian Bonifacio, an AFP military nurse, secretly works as a spy for the man she believes is her father, Santiago Guerrero, who has raised her to seek revenge against military general Marcial de Leon. As Rhian uncovers the truth about her origins, she finds herself torn between loyalty to the family that raised her and her duty to justice, leading to a dangerous conflict involving family, betrayal, and redemption

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: E37
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: E3 - Autumn
programme.desc: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

programme.title: E2 - The Lifesavers
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa’s most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: E3 - The Partners
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher’s pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: E3 - Aerial Hunters
programme.desc: Australia’s birds of prey are some of the region's fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australia’s aerial hunters.

programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. programme.title: E3 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. Moving the national animal of Bulgaria across international borders is something powers high up a

programme.title: E7 - Durham - Henry VIII
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette take on the stunning River Wear - a natural fortress protecting the ancient city of Durham and its sacred Cathedral. This is where in the 1500’s, Henry VIII seized power of the Church and the Cathedral’s shrines were plundered. Now Rick and Beau, joined by Durham’s diving archeologist Gary Bankhead, are hunting for hidden treasures to uncover evidence of what life was like from this majestic city’s turbulent past.

He escaped into Zhi's house and put the diamond into the facial cream of Zhi and then quitted. Unluckily, Zhi was mistaken by the other three that she was his member and helped to receive the loot. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks...

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。
